notes: Locality reference is the logical answer; the scoring gold is the model's own pre-edit answer. Derived premises are true facts about real English words, stated in the prompt. The premises are true, so the new answers go against world knowledge: 'their' and 'there', and 'flower' and 'flour', differ in meaning. Slot 0025 held a reflexivity edit ('is an antonym of' is reflexive) until 2026-10-22, when reflexivity was dropped as an RBox property: its only instances ask whether a thing is related to itself.
